summary_en: TOBA raised its dividend per share for fiscal year ending March 2027 from 120 yen to 160 yen, a 40 yen increase. The company simultaneously introduced a new shareholder return policy featuring a DOE (dividend on equity) floor of 2.0% and raised the consolidated payout ratio requirement from 35% to 50%, effective from fiscal 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Changes in Basic Policy for Shareholder Returns (Introduction of DOE Metric) and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, TOBA revised its shareholder return policy and increased its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The company raised the annual dividend per share by 40 yen to 160 yen, moving from the previous forecast of 120 yen announced on May 8, 2026.

The revision accompanies a fundamental overhaul of the company's shareholder return framework, effective from fiscal 2027. TOBA replaced its previous dividend policy with a new approach featuring two key metrics: a DOE (dividend on equity) floor of 2.0% and a consolidated payout ratio minimum of 50%, compared to the previous thresholds of no specific DOE floor and a 35% payout ratio. The company maintained a minimum dividend per share policy but removed the specific 40 yen figure from the stated policy. TOBA stated that the enhanced policy aims to strengthen profit distribution to shareholders and improve shareholder value through dividends while ensuring continued stable management and growth.
